posts.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank account (DBT).
Paid in 3 installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months (April-July, August-November, December-March).
100% funding by the Central Government of India without intermediaries.
Special Kisan Credit Card (KCC) loan facility at 4% subsidized interest rate.
eligibilityCriteria: All small and marginal landholding farmer families who own cultivable land.
Must have Aadhaar card linked with Bank Account and active mobile number.
Land revenue records (Khatauni / Khasra) verified in state portal.
Institutional landholders, income tax payers, and government employees are excluded.
posts.whoCanApply: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding in their name as per land records.
howToApplySteps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit Shahnawaz Computer Center.
Click on "New Farmer Registration" under Farmers Corner.
Select Rural Farmer Registration or Urban Farmer Registration and enter Aadhaar Number & Mobile.
Verify Aadhaar OTP, choose State, District, Sub-District, Block and Village.
Enter Land record Khata number, Khasra number, Area (in Hectares) and upload land deed.
Submit form and complete facial or OTP e-KYC.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card (Mandatory)
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar Seeded / DBT Enabled)
